target.title: fix(github-copilot): preserve thinking levels for Claude models
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `/thinking high|low|medium` was rejected with "not supported for github-copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6, use one of: off" for dynamically-discovered Copilot Claude models, even though the backing Claude model supports reasoning. Only `off` was advertised.

## Why This Change Was Made

Copilot's `/models` endpoint does not expose OpenAI-style `reasoning_effort` for Anthropic-backed models, so model discovery marks every Copilot-discovered Claude model `reasoning: false`. The shared thinking resolver (`src/auto-reply/thinking.ts`) then discarded this provider's declared level set and fell back to off-only, because the github-copilot profile did not set `preserveWhenCatalogReasoningFalse`. The fix sets that flag for Claude models (detected via the existing `anthropic-messages` transport signal), mirroring `anthropic`, `amazon-bedrock`, `google`, and `moonshot`, which already set it for the same reason. This preserves the levels the hook already declares (`off/minimal/low/medium/high`) and invents no new ones; non-Claude Copilot models without `reasoning_effort` stay off-only.

## User Impact

Users running Copilot-routed Claude models (e.g. `claude-sonnet-4.6`, `claude-opus-4.7`) can use `/thinking high|low|medium` as expected, instead of being locked to `off`.

## Evidence

- Two tests in `extensions/github-copilot/index.test.ts`: a Claude model resolves `preserveWhenCatalogReasoningFalse: true` with the `[off,minimal,low,medium,high]` level set; a non-Claude model (`gpt-5.4-mini`) leaves the flag unset (so non-reasoning Copilot models stay off-only).
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-providers.config.ts extensions/github-copilot` thinking tests: 6/6 pass (4 existing + 2 new). The full github-copilot suite only has pre-existing Windows `EBUSY` SQLite-teardown flakes in token-onboarding tests, unrelated to this change.

🤖 AI-assisted. Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code).

Closes #99240
